scripts.db:up: doppler run -- docker compose  -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml up -d
scripts.db:down: doppler run -- docker compose  -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml stop
scripts.db:logs: doppler run -- docker compose  -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml logs -f postgres
scripts.db:status: doppler run -- docker compose  -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml ps
scripts.db:shell: doppler run -- docker compose  -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yaml exec postgres psql -U saas_app -d multi_tenant_saas
